list: the official 55 trophies, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles on 18 November 2026
note: Names, descriptions and grades are shown exactly as PlayStation publishes them. Every guide below is written for this entry, in its own words, and names its sources beside it.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are earned — there is no extra task of its own. Follow the roadmap in this guide: story first, then the 100% completion checklist, then the last side strands and clean-up. Everything is single-player and offline, and no DLC is needed.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Finish Gone Fishing, the first main mission of Chapter 1, and it pops when the mission ends. It cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Automatic. Complete Chapter 1 — the trophy pops when the first main mission of Chapter 2, “What’s in the Bag?”, is done. Unmissable.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Automatic. Complete Chapter 2; it pops after the first main mission of Chapter 3, “Welcome to Vice City”.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Automatic. Complete Chapter 3; it pops after the first two main missions of Chapter 4, “Ocean Beach” and “Another Life”.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Automatic. Complete Chapter 4; it pops after the final main mission of Chapter 4, “Starting From Zero”.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Automatic story gold. Complete the final mission of the game (Chapter 5). Keep a manual save from just before the finale — there is no mission replay, so a save is your only way back.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Automatic. Complete the Chapter 2 main mission “Breakfast Run”.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Automatic. Complete the Chapter 3 main mission “The Cartel Heist”.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Automatic. Complete the Chapter 4 main mission “Child’s Play”.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Automatic. Complete the Chapter 4 main mission “Headliners”.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Automatic. Complete the Chapter 4 main mission “VCIA Takedown”.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Automatic. Complete the Chapter 5 main mission “Operation Savage Glory”.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The big one, and the hardest trophy in the set. After the story, open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion — progress made during the story already counts, and nothing on the list is missable. The requirements are lenient, closer to 60% true completion: any 100 optional missions, scan 200 of 277 base-model vehicles, study 100 of 255 animals through binoculars, 300 stunts, any 70 of 80 challenges, plus all robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret’s quests. Most of it falls out of the other trophies.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Any 250 of the 397 stunts count, mixing the four types: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps. Under-the-bridge flights are the quickest to rack up. Track progress by region under Progress > Activities > Stunts, and keep going past 250 — the 100% checklist wants 300.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: The tracker counts 9 activity types: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a race (car race, race challenge or drone race) and performing a stunt. Do one of each — check Touchpad > Progress > Activities to see what is left. You will tick most of them off naturally while chasing the other trophies.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the 12 ranges. Each range holds its own set of challenges; the gold thresholds are forgiving and a failed run restarts in seconds, so treat it as a short grind rather than a skill wall.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations — there are 42 races in total, but one win per location is enough. Race locations appear as you unfog the map. Fly the course clean rather than flat-out and retry the tricky ones; the 100% checklist needs every drone race won anyway.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win at 20 different race locations — there are 40 unique ones across Leonida. Car races, race challenges and drone races all feed the count. Use the fastest car you own, learn the route on a first run, then win it; only wins at new locations count.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 mission “Feng Shui” introduces Cal, he texts you a fishing spot (purple map icon). Follow Cal’s fishing questline and beat him in the challenge it sets up. It is a patience test, not a gear check — watch the line and reel steadily.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish any one of the four arcade games (“Video Games” in-game): Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind or Bang For Your Buck. The first three play on the TV at home from Chapter 1; Bang For Your Buck is on arcade machines around the world. You only need to reach the end of one game, not beat every challenge inside it.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Lucia-only. In Chapter 3 Andy calls and then texts her home address in Belville, marking a five-quest line: Climbing the Cellerichain (parts 1–3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass. Finish all five; the quests stay available after the story.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton’s line starts in Chapter 1, after the mission “Island Dreams” — he calls, then shows as a green “KR” icon in Key Lento. He marks shipwreck treasure sites (purple chest icons): dive down, dig the treasure out of the ocean floor with the metal detector and bring it back. Clear all 7 shipwreck sets. Kenton goes quiet for a while in Chapter 2 but returns, so nothing here is missable.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy’s line opens after the Chapter 2 mission “Coffee Break”, marked at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Five quests: Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes. All of them stay open after the story.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 stranger strands — but only certain questlines count. Andy’s, Billy’s, Tyrone’s, Moses’ and Yasmani’s do not, because they have their own trophies. Strands confirmed to count: Kirk’s Skunk Ape hunt, Kyle’s farm jobs, Yago’s street-racing strand and Pilot Pete’s deliveries. Watch out for Yago’s “Race Against Yago”: it is time-sensitive (hourglass icon), so save first and race the moment it appears. Check the trophy’s progress counter after each strand.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy’s “Wish List” opens after the Chapter 3 mission “Clonin’ Keys, Makin’ GS”, where you steal the Zorrusso and unlock the Key Cloner. He wants 16 sports cars delivered to his garage (green “RK” icon, west Vice City). Scan cars with the WAiNK app to check them against the list, steal them anywhere, and deliver them in good condition for better pay. Track it under Map > Robberies > Randy’s Wish List.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Jason-only. After the Chapter 3 mission “Here, Kitty Kitty”, purple markers appear for Synthetic Labs around Vice City — go in and destroy them in the quest “Take Out Kitty Litter”. Destroy enough labs and Tyrone hands you the second quest, “Spin On This”; finish it for the trophy. Everything stays available after the story.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across 10 locations (track under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations). Meditate with both Jason and Lucia at a spot and it counts twice. THE ONE MISSABLE TROPHY: during Chapter 1, after the mission “Down to Earth”, Lucia may head to the balcony of Jason’s house to meditate in the morning — follow her, accept, and do it; it is gone after Chapter 1. Keep a Chapter 1 save until the trophy pops. For the 100% checklist only 15 of 18 meditations are needed, so the balcony one may or may not count toward the trophy — do it anyway.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Jason-only. After the Chapter 2 mission “Coffee Break”, Bret Vogel texts Jason and marks “Veteran Hunted” in Lummox County. His line is hunting: he marks animals on the map (purple icons) and you bring them back to him. The first quest hands you the unique rifle “Killtelligence SM-69” — one clean shot keeps a carcass pristine and pays more. Track the 15 Target Decks under Map > Activities; all 15 are needed for 100% anyway, so this comes naturally.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete any 3 collectible card sets. Cards are hidden around Leonida, and guides map all 18 card set locations. You do not need every card in the game, just three full sets — pick the sets whose cards cluster together and clear them in one sweep.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan 100 WAiNK objects with the phone app (hold Up, then R1 on a target). Any 100 count — there are far more than that: 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures and the No Flusher tags. Scan whatever you pass while driving and it fills up on its own.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges (Progress > Challenges). The 100% checklist needs 70 of 80, so this pops on the way there — leave the hardest 10 alone and pick the easy ones last. Most challenges complete naturally while you work on the other trophies.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Needs Jason and Lucia together, unlocked after Chapter 2’s “Coffee Break” (call your partner with hold Right + Triangle). Build a 4-star wanted level, then escape the red heat zone — not just the flashing search area. An easy route is the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County, where the helicopter cannot follow you. It also pops naturally while robbing the large bank vaults in Chapter 4.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, rob 3 shops back-to-back without the wanted level dropping — keep the flashing wanted stars alive between shops. The pop is delayed about 30 seconds after the third shop; if it does not come, hit a fourth. The three jewelry stores in north Vice City work well (open after Chapter 3’s “Yasmani’s Jewelry Jobs”): loot a couple of items and crack the back-room safe in each.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles — scanning with the WAiNK app counts, you do not need to drive them. Stand on a busy road and scan passing traffic. There are 557 vehicles at launch; the 100% checklist needs 200 of 277 base models scanned, so this pops early in that grind. Check totals under Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Down 5 enemies in one use of Combat Focus (L3 + R3 while aiming — time slows and weak points light up). Buff Focus first with food, a drink or a wash at home, and pop Adrenaline to stretch the window. Line up a group — gang-operation guards are ideal — and use a full-auto rifle like the Duke 556. It does not count against soldiers, police or civilians. Focus reaches level 4 naturally as you play shooting ranges, golf, pool and fishing.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane docked at a boarding bridge at VCIA (Vice City International Airport) — planes parked on the open airfield do not count. The E3/E4 gates work: enter through the terminal or drive through a fence, board via the stairs by the bridge, get to the cockpit, reverse to the runway and take off. Fly about 1 km from the airport and the trophy pops — it is delayed, so keep flying.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank from Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the far south-west of the map in Mariana County — the tanks stand in the south of the base. Drive through the gate (or take the stunt jump by the south-east entrance), climb in and fire until the trophy pops. Expect a 3-star wanted level the moment you roll out.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 3 mission “Yasmani’s Jewelry Jobs” to get the Snap Gun, which silently lockpicks alarmed doors. Pick a jewelry store (green icon), use the Snap Gun on the back door instead of kicking it in, find the note with the safe code in the back room, open the safe and leave unseen. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a reliable target.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob any 5 bank vaults and escape. Vaults open with the Chapter 4 optional mission “That’s Where The Money Is…” — tail a security van to a large bank, slip in while the guard has the vault open (bring your partner: you cannot carry all the cash alone), then escape the 4-star heat. After that, Yasmani sells van tips for $10,000 each. There are 8 large bank jobs and the 100% checklist needs all of them, so this pops on the way; a single vault can pay up to $205,000.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. It pops automatically in the same Chapter 4 mission as Maximum Withdrawal — tailing the van to a bank vault counts as the truck robbery. Earlier method: block an armored truck near a bank, sticky-bomb its back door, grab the cash and escape the red heat zone (a Pay ’n’ Spray helps). Sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani’s shop after his quests.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Fully unfog the map — all 52 areas of Leonida. The fastest way is by plane: fly over every black-fogged region until the map is clear. It ticks along naturally as you travel, so save it for a dedicated sweep after the story.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation for each of the 9 gangs. Operations show as yellow icons when you get near them, and many are marked automatically from story progress; track per-gang counts under Progress > Gangs. The 100% checklist needs all 39 operations, so this pops while you clear them.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: No confirmed method yet — the description is the only clue: a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The trophy guide that tracks this list marks it as currently unknown. Most likely it pops from a specific beachside spot or story beat on Ocean Beach, so try the Ocean Beach bars and viewpoints while exploring, and check the sources below for updates as players pin it down.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: No confirmed method yet — the trophy guide that tracks this list marks it as currently unknown. The description points to smashing out of a vehicle showroom “in classic style”, so it is most likely tied to a showroom robbery or a specific story moment. Watch the linked guides for the first confirmed report rather than grinding showrooms blind.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Rob Kingpin Bowling (the Kolt & Associates alley in Port Gellhorn), an illegal operation you first visit in the Chapter 2 optional mission “Hit Kingpin Bowling”. Take all 3 key valuables: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique “Gutterball Moreland 850” shotgun on a north-east table, and the office safe in the north-east hallway — blow it open with sticky bombs (buy them at Ammu-Nation first). The trophy pops after you escape the police. If you miss an item, the operation respawns later — not missable.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Get Jason and Lucia to maximum Strength at the same time. Check Strength under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia (heart icon). Buy a gym membership and always train with your partner along (hold Right + Triangle to call them) — while one works out, the other trains too, doubling progress. Available after Chapter 2’s “Coffee Break” unlocks switching.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile — the trophy list itself shows the running count. Turn on Criminal Profile notifications (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications) so you see the demon-face icon whenever an action counts. Robberies and fights feed it passively. Avoid pushing the profile to “Irredeemable” — that status is permanent and makes police far more aggressive.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: No confirmed method yet. The trophy guide that tracks this list marks it as unknown and believes it relates to the Payday Loans store from the prologue — “second time’s the charm” suggests retrying something there. Treat it as unconfirmed and check the linked guides for the first verified report.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: No confirmed method yet. The trophy guide that tracks this list marks it as unknown and believes it is tied to a UFO questline. If a UFO strand appears in your game, follow it — otherwise wait for a confirmed report in the linked guides.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: No confirmed method yet. The trophy guide that tracks this list marks it as unknown and believes it comes from kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle. Try melee drive-by kicks from a bike at enemies; otherwise wait for a confirmed report in the linked guides.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 in Marked Bills through your contacts (fences). First finish the Chapter 3 mission “Credit Check” to meet Raul’s crew and unlock the Dye Pack Jammer. Marked bills come from bank and Payday Loan robberies; sell them to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The total is cumulative, and bank vaults alone can drop up to $205,000 in a single job.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — the total is cumulative and every shop type counts. Guns, car mods and tattoos are the fastest way to burn cash. Shop counts: 24 Ammu-Nations, 14 mod shops, 67 clothing stores, 11 tattoo studios, 15 electronics stores, 17 footwear stores and 18 hair & beauty salons. It pops naturally if you buy gear as you go.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages (about $160,000 in total) through the Vice City Real Estate phone app, which unlocks after the Chapter 2 mission “Daily Driver”. The 4 garages the story gives you do not count. Fund it with robberies — the higher-value jobs in Chapters 3–4 pay best. Garages also add the parking space you need for “On the Spot”.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app, which arrives after the Chapter 2 mission “Moses”. Drive a stolen car to Moses in Port Gellhorn, choose Respray then Register. At first he only takes cars without trackers; from Chapter 3 you can also register standard-tracker cars at any Pay ’n’ Spray. Each registration needs a free garage space, so buy garages first, and register cheap cars to keep the cost down.
